results.name: game_state_dispatch_load_callbacks
results.evidence: iterates a fixed table of 13 function pointers at PTR_FUN_0069e7b4 calling each in turn; the identical loop is inlined in FUN_00538200 and game_state_load_core right after a checkpoint/save load completes
results.summary: Calls each of 13 registered subsystem callback pointers in sequence, used to notify subsystems after a saved-game load/revert completes.

results.name: game_state_startup
results.evidence: seeds the running CRC (DAT_006e2dd4=-1), calls FUN_005385f0 to allocate the save buffer, calls the file-creation helper, then reserves 0x14c bytes for the header and folds that size into the CRC
results.summary: One-time initialization of the saved-game subsystem: allocates the working buffer, creates the persistent storage file, and reserves/accounts for the header block.

results.name: game_state_build_header
results.evidence: zeroes a 0x14c-byte header block at DAT_006e2de0, copies the current scenario/map name from the tag array (DAT_0069e8d4*0x20+0x10+DAT_0087bc14), writes a literal build-version string and map id/checksum fields, and stores the running CRC into header[0]
results.summary: Populates the saved-game header with the current scenario name, engine build-version string, map id and checksum.

results.name: game_state_new
results.evidence: takes a name and element count, computes size = count*stride+0x38 (stride passed in unaff_BX), carves a block out of the running save buffer, zero-fills a 0x38-byte block header, copies the name (strncpy, 0x1f max), stores count/stride and a 4-byte type tag '@t@d', and a self pointer to the data area; called from 16 sites
results.summary: Registers a new named array inside the saved-game buffer (Blam-style data_new pattern), returning a pointer to its block header.

results.name: game_state_new_pool
results.evidence: same block-carving pattern as FUN_005380d0 but writes a 'pool' fourcc tag (0x706f6f6c) and initializes free-list style count fields ([0xc],[0xd]) and capacity fields ([10],[0xb]) instead of a simple array header
results.summary: Registers a named pool-style (free-list) allocator block inside the saved-game buffer, analogous to game_state_new but for pooled data.

results.name: game_state_save
results.evidence: invokes a single registered callback (PTR_FUN_0069e7ac), clears busy flags, calls FUN_00538700 (which snapshots the buffer and signals the async write thread), then sets a ready flag from its result
results.summary: Top-level entry point that triggers a saved-game snapshot/commit: runs a pre-save callback, queues the async write, and records whether it succeeded.

results.name: game_state_perform_revert
results.evidence: early-outs with default sentinel values when no valid save exists (DAT_006e2dd9==0) and not in a revertable mode (DAT_00746fa4==0); otherwise waits for the IO-busy flag, calls the already-named chimera__revert primitive, re-reads the persistent storage via FUN_00539330, then dispatches the 13-entry load-callback table
results.summary: Performs a full checkpoint revert: waits for pending IO, invokes the low-level revert primitive, reloads state from disk, and notifies subsystems.

results.name: game_state_load_checkpoint
results.evidence: reads/validates the persistent file via FUN_00539570 and FUN_00538430, checks the stored scenario id (local_26) against the current one (DAT_00696564), and on a match calls chimera__revert, commits it via FUN_00539850, updates DAT_006b0b80+0xe, and dispatches load callbacks
results.summary: Loads and applies the persistent saved-game file as the active checkpoint if its embedded scenario id matches the currently running scenario.

results.name: game_state_checkpoint_get_name
results.evidence: reads a small header block via FUN_00539570 then copies the embedded scenario/name string (local_148) out through register out-parameters (unaff_ESI/unaff_EDI)
results.summary: Reads the persistent checkpoint header and returns its embedded name/id via register out-parameters, likely for UI display.

results.name: game_state_load_core
results.evidence: existing name confirmed by code and the referenced strings "loaded '%s'"/"couldn't open '%s'": reads the profile header, validates version via FUN_00538430, reads the body, and logs success/failure
results.summary: Loads and validates the saved-game/profile file, logging success or failure, and on success reverts state and dispatches load callbacks.

results.name: saved_game_verify_version_and_checksum
results.evidence: compares a 13-byte build-version string embedded in the header against a fixed list of older known build strings ("01.00.03.0606" .. "01.00.10.0621"), and additionally compares the header's CRC/map-id/checksum fields against the current build's tag data and DAT_006e2dd4/DAT_006894b8/DAT_006a81b8
results.summary: Validates that a saved-game header's build-version string and checksum/map-id fields match the running build, optionally reporting an error on mismatch.

results.name: game_state_allocate_buffer
results.evidence: matches the cea-pdb hint 'game_state_allocate_buffer'; GlobalAlloc's the save-state working buffer, builds the "savegame.bin" and secondary file paths via snprintf, creates the write-completion event, and starts the async save thread (FUN_00538980) via __beginthread
results.summary: Allocates the saved-game working buffer, builds its on-disk file paths, and starts the background save-writer thread.

results.name: game_state_create_persistent_storage_file
results.evidence: creates savegame.bin at the path built in FUN_005385f0 (CreateFileA), seeks to 0x480000 and calls SetEndOfFile to size it, setting DAT_006e2df4=1 on success or reporting an IO error (FUN_0057ea70(0x8b,0x8c,1)) on failure; the chimera__ prefix is a stale signature-scanner hint, not the real behavior
results.summary: Creates and pre-sizes the savegame.bin persistent storage file used by the async save system.

results.name: game_state_queue_write
results.evidence: waits for the IO-busy flag, memcpy's the snapshot buffer (DAT_006e2dec) into the pending-write buffer (DAT_006e2de4) sized DAT_006e2df0, stores the 'final' flag (DAT_006e3001=param_1), and SetEvent's the write-thread's event
results.summary: Snapshots the current save data into the pending-write buffer and signals the background save-writer thread to flush it to disk.

results.name: saved_game_file_exists
results.evidence: builds a "%s%s.sav" path and checks it with FindFirstFileA/FindClose, returning whether the checkpoint file exists (callers=0, so unused/dead in retail)
results.summary: Checks whether a named checkpoint .sav file exists on disk.

results.name: saved_game_copy_files_to_target
results.evidence: if the source "%s%s.sav" exists, CopyFileA's both the .bin and .sav companion files to a target name; called with literal names "checkpoints\\autosave1", "checkpoints\\autosave" and "savegame" from other functions in this batch
results.summary: Duplicates the current .bin/.sav checkpoint file pair under a new target name (used for autosave rotation and checkpoint loading).

results.name: saved_game_delete_files
results.evidence: if the "%s%s.sav" file exists, DeleteFileA's both the .bin and .sav companion files, returning success if at least one delete succeeded
results.summary: Deletes a checkpoint's .bin/.sav file pair from disk.

results.name: game_state_save_thread_proc
results.evidence: the thread entry passed to __beginthread in FUN_005385f0; loops on WaitForSingleObject(DAT_006e2ffc), writes the pending buffer to the savegame.bin handle in 0x4000-byte chunks, and on the 'final' flag also writes the stats file (FUN_00538b70) and rotates autosave/autosave1 copies (FUN_005387e0)
results.summary: Background thread that asynchronously flushes queued saved-game data to savegame.bin and rotates autosave checkpoint copies.

results.name: game_checkpoint_get_next_filename
results.evidence: loops checkpoint index 0..99 building "checkpoints\\checkpoint%d" and probing with FindFirstFileA until a free slot is found; if all 100 are taken, falls back to FUN_00538e70 with a callback to reclaim a slot
results.summary: Finds the next unused checkpoint filename slot (checkpoint0..checkpoint99), or reclaims one via the checkpoint enumerator if all slots are full.

results.name: game_checkpoint_write_stats_file
results.evidence: opens "savegame.sav" as a text file, writes a score triple (via FUN_004c8b90) and the current local date/time (GetLocalTime) as CSV lines with fprintf
results.summary: Writes a companion .sav text file recording the score and timestamp for a checkpoint/save.

results.name: game_checkpoint_read_stats_file
results.evidence: opens the companion .sav text file and fscanf's the same score-triple/date/time CSV lines written by FUN_00538b70, returning them through param_2/param_3 out pointers; used by the checkpoint enumerator FUN_00538e70
results.summary: Reads back a checkpoint's companion .sav stats file (score and date/time) written by game_checkpoint_write_stats_file.

results.name: game_checkpoint_save_new
results.evidence: waits for the IO-busy flag, finds a free checkpoint slot via FUN_00538ae0, then copies the active save into it via FUN_005387e0 (callers=0, unused in retail)
results.summary: Creates a brand-new checkpoint by finding a free slot and copying the current save data into it.

results.name: saved_game_checkpoint_compare
results.evidence: qsort comparator (passed to _qsort in FUN_00538e70) that compares two checkpoint entries first by a size/id field at offset 0x24 then by CompareFileTime, direction flipped by DAT_0069e7e8
results.summary: qsort comparison callback used to order enumerated checkpoint entries by id then file write time.

results.name: game_checkpoint_enumerate_files
results.evidence: enumerates "checkpoints\\*.sav" (up to 0x66 entries) via FindFirstFileA/FindNextFileA, reads each entry's stats via FUN_00538c60, classifies autosave/autosave1 names, sorts the list with _qsort using FUN_00538e30, then invokes a caller-supplied callback (param_3) per entry
results.summary: Enumerates and sorts all checkpoint files on disk, invoking a callback for each one (used to build the load-checkpoint UI list and to reclaim slots).

results.name: saved_game_load_checkpoint_by_name
results.evidence: checks the named checkpoint's .sav file exists, reads its difficulty field via FUN_00538c60 and applies it to DAT_00696564, calls FUN_004c8740, then copies the checkpoint's files over the active "savegame" via FUN_005387e0 unless the name already is "savegame"
results.summary: Loads a specific named checkpoint into the active save slot, restoring its difficulty setting.

results.name: saved_game_load_checkpoint
results.evidence: wrapper that defaults an empty name to "autosave", treats "*" as "enumerate all checkpoints" (calling FUN_00538e70 with a UI callback), otherwise prefixes "checkpoints\\" and forwards to FUN_005391a0
results.summary: High-level load-checkpoint entry point used by the menu: resolves a checkpoint name (or wildcard) and loads it.

results.name: game_state_read_persistent_storage
results.evidence: waits for the IO-busy flag, then SetFilePointer+ReadFile's DAT_006e2df0 bytes from the long-lived persistent-storage handle DAT_006e2df8 into the buffer DAT_006e2dec, reporting an IO error on failure
results.summary: Reads the full saved-game body from the open persistent-storage handle into the working buffer.

results.name: game_state_write_profile_file
results.evidence: creates the profile directory (DAT_006e2efc), builds "%s\\%s", CreateFileA's the target with CREATE_ALWAYS, and WriteFile's the given buffer/length
results.summary: Writes a buffer out to a named file in the saved-game/profile directory (open-each-call variant, distinct from the async savegame.bin path).

results.name: game_state_read_profile_header
results.evidence: opens a file under DAT_006e2efc with OPEN_EXISTING and ReadFile's into the caller's buffer, returning a bool; called first by game_state_load_core with a small (0x14c-byte) stack buffer before the version check
results.summary: Reads a small header-sized block from the profile file, returning success/failure without raising a fatal error.

results.name: game_state_read_profile_file
results.evidence: same open/read pattern as FUN_00539460 but reports a fatal IO error (FUN_0057ea70) on failure instead of returning a bool; called by game_state_load_core with the full save buffer after the header has already validated
results.summary: Reads the full profile/save file body into the working buffer, treating failure as a fatal error.

results.name: saved_game_validate_crc
results.evidence: opens the persistent file via FUN_005398e0, reads it in up to 0x20000-byte chunks accumulating a crc32_update, and compares the result against the caller-supplied expected value, deleting the file on mismatch when FUN_0053d080() allows it
results.summary: Verifies the on-disk saved-game file's CRC against an expected checksum, deleting it if corrupt/mismatched.

results.name: game_state_write_persistent_storage
results.evidence: opens the file via FUN_005398e0, computes a crc32_update over the buffer, writes the header (param_1) then a second data block (local_808) via WriteFile at fixed offsets, reporting/deleting on failure
results.summary: Writes the checksum, header and body of the current save data out to the persistent storage file.

results.name: game_state_read_persistent_storage_block
results.evidence: opens a fresh handle via FUN_005398e0(0) each call (unlike FUN_00539330 which reuses a long-lived handle), SetFilePointer's to 0 and ReadFile's a caller-sized block, reporting an IO error and deleting the file on failure
results.summary: Reads a block from the persistent storage file using a freshly-opened handle, used by the checkpoint-load path.

results.name: game_state_open_persistent_storage
results.evidence: matches the cea-pdb hint via the "savegame.bin" string; CreateFileA's savegame.bin (creating it if needed), and if newly created zero-fills and writes an initial 0x4000-byte block then extends the file to 0x480000 via SetFilePointer+SetEndOfFile
results.summary: Opens (creating and pre-sizing if necessary) the savegame.bin persistent storage file, returning its handle.

results.name: player_profile_await_verify_thread
results.evidence: polls GetExitCodeThread on DAT_0072127c until it exits, closes the handle and clears it, then zero-fills a 0x1001-dword (~16KB) cached buffer at DAT_0071d280 that FUN_00539bc0 later returns as the default/cached profile
results.summary: Waits for a background profile-verification thread to finish, then clears the cached default-profile buffer it produced.

results.name: player_profile_submit_for_verification
results.evidence: builds an 8188-byte (0x1ffc) packet containing a wide player name (wcsncpy from in_ECX) and a crc32_update checksum, then calls network send helpers (FUN_005558f0/FUN_00555a90) or a cleanup path (FUN_0053c960) on failure
results.summary: Builds and submits a checksummed profile-identity packet (including the player's name) for network verification.

results.name: player_profile_get_cached
results.evidence: when in_ECX==-1, copies the cached default profile buffer (DAT_0071d280, 0x7ff dwords) into the caller's output buffer; otherwise forwards to FUN_0053a770
results.summary: Returns the cached default profile data directly, or delegates to player_profile_get for a real profile index.

results.name: player_profile_save
results.evidence: matches the cea-pdb hint via the exact string "profile not saved since it was a default profile": if in_EAX==-1 (no real profile) it prints that warning via FUN_004c6860, otherwise it calls the real save implementation FUN_0053a950
results.summary: Saves the active player profile, or prints a warning instead if it is only the default (unsaved) profile.

results.name: player_color_get_rgb
results.evidence: clamps a color index (in_ECX, 0..0x11) into a 17-entry packed-RGB table at DAT_0069e7f0 and converts each byte channel to a float by multiplying by 1/255 (0.003921569) into the out-parameter in_EAX
results.summary: Looks up a player color index in the color table and converts it to a normalized (0..1) float RGB triple.

results.name: player_profile_select
results.evidence: validates the local profile slot (param_1 must be 0), checks its validity flag in DAT_00714dd4, copies the 0x7ff-dword profile struct out of DAT_00712dd8, and calls the established player_profile_load if its cached checksum changed
results.summary: Switches the active player profile to the given local slot, reloading it if its cached copy is stale.

results.name: player_profile_select_with_level_flag
results.evidence: same slot-validation and profile-copy pattern as FUN_00539cb0, but additionally sets a bit in a per-profile bitmap (abStack_1eea) using the current scenario/map id from DAT_006b0b80+0xe before always saving and reloading the profile
results.summary: Switches the active player profile like player_profile_select, but also flags the current scenario/map as visited in the profile before saving.

results.name: control_binding_scan_flags
results.evidence: scans 10 groups of parallel byte-flag arrays (5 bytes per group) at fixed offsets from a caller-supplied pointer, testing bits 1/2/4/8 to classify a 'type' (0-3) and record the highest-indexed set entry via register out-parameters
results.summary: Scans a table of per-slot byte flags to find the last (highest-priority) active entry and its type, purpose not fully certain from code alone.

results.name: control_profile_reset_digital_bindings
results.evidence: fills the profile's digital-binding array (offset 0x134, 0x36 words) with the unbound sentinel 0x7fff, then overwrites a fixed set of entries with specific default action ids (9,0x13,0x14,...) matching Halo PC's default keyboard bindings
results.summary: Resets a control profile's digital (button/key) action bindings to their default values.

results.name: control_profile_reset_analog_bindings
results.evidence: fills the profile's analog-axis binding block (offset 0x20e) with the unbound sentinel 0x7fff7fff, then overwrites specific entries with default axis ids (7,6,0xb,0x17,0x18,0x1a)
results.summary: Resets a control profile's analog (axis) action bindings to their default values.

results.name: game_engine_set_default_server_options
results.evidence: hinted by cea-pdb as sv_start_new_server_with_name_and_password_from_profile via the "Halo" string; sets a wide default server name (L"Halo") and empty password plus a handful of difficulty/game-option default bytes on a caller-selected struct
results.summary: Sets default server name/password and game-option fields, used when starting a server without an existing profile.

results.name: player_profile_initialize
results.evidence: zero-fills and default-initializes a full ~0x7ff-dword profile struct (calling control_profile_reset_digital_bindings/analog_bindings and the default video-options setter), sets the default name L"Halo", and optionally copies in existing control-binding data from DAT_00712dd8 or via player_profile_get when param_3 is set
results.summary: Builds a fresh player profile with all default settings, optionally merging in existing control-binding data.

results.name: player_profile_write_default_files
results.evidence: loops twice, default-initializing a profile via FUN_0053a1c0, builds "%s\\%02d.sav" paths, tags the block with a 'file' fourcc, computes a crc32_update over the 0x1ffc-byte struct, then writes it out via a chain of file/network helper calls
results.summary: Generates and writes the two default profile save files (00.sav/01.sav) to disk.

results.name: player_profile_get
results.evidence: for param_1>=0 builds and returns a fresh default profile (via FUN_0053a1c0 + FUN_0053c600 for the name); for param_1<0 it waits on a mutex, validates a cached profile via crc32_update against a stored checksum, and falls back to a fresh default if invalid; used by 12 call sites across this batch
results.summary: Core accessor returning profile data for a given index, or the currently active (checksum-verified) profile with a default fallback.

results.name: player_profile_write_data
results.evidence: copies the caller's 0x7ff-dword profile buffer, crc32_update's it, and writes it out via FUN_005558f0/FUN_00555a90, calling a cache-update helper (FUN_0053ce80) on success or a cleanup/retry path (FUN_0053c960) on failure; called from 7 sites including player_profile_save's real-save branch
results.summary: Low-level routine that checksums and persists a player profile's data, updating derived cache state on success.

results.name: control_profile_find_binding_for_scancode
results.evidence: given a raw input code (sVar2) it scans the keyboard (DAT_0071508e), mouse (DAT_007150aa/DAT_007151ba) and joystick (DAT_007153ba) default binding tables and returns a descriptor (type/index/sub-index) via out-parameters
results.summary: Resolves a raw scan/device code to an internal control-binding descriptor by searching the keyboard/mouse/joystick default tables.

results.name: control_profile_clear_binding
results.evidence: given a binding descriptor (type 1/2/3 from unaff_ESI), writes the unbound sentinel 0x7fff into the corresponding digital/mouse/joystick-axis binding slot
results.summary: Clears (unbinds) a specific control binding identified by a descriptor.

results.name: control_profile_set_binding
results.evidence: mirrors control_profile_clear_binding but writes param_1 as the new value into the descriptor's slot, with special-case exclusivity handling for values 8/9 (clearing a conflicting opposite binding)
results.summary: Assigns a new value to a specific control binding identified by a descriptor, clearing a conflicting default binding when needed.

results.name: player_profile_set_default_video_options
results.evidence: sets default display width/height/refresh fields (0xa68/0xa6a/0xa6c) using rasterizer_parse_vidmode_commandline and display_mode_get_current, falling back to 800x600@60 when not dedicated and no valid vidmode override exists
results.summary: Fills in default video/display settings (resolution, refresh rate) for a profile, honoring a command-line video mode override if present.

results.name: network_options_set_defaults_by_connection_quality
results.evidence: duplicates the connection-quality-based default block seen inline in player_profile_initialize (thresholds on DAT_00722bac/DAT_00722ba8), setting fields at offset 0xb78-0xb7f based on whether the connection appears fast enough
results.summary: Sets default network/connection-related option fields based on measured connection quality thresholds.

results.name: control_profile_reset_slot
results.evidence: given a profile-array base and slot index (0-3), zero-fills the slot's binding block then re-fills its analog/axis sub-arrays with the 0x7fff7fff unbound sentinel
results.summary: Resets one of the four control-profile slots to its all-unbound default state.

results.name: control_profile_is_customized
results.evidence: scans a profile slot's digital, mouse-axis, joystick-axis-id and joystick-button-axis sub-arrays and returns true as soon as any entry differs from the default unbound sentinel
results.summary: Checks whether a control-profile slot has any bindings different from the default (unbound) state.

results.name: control_profile_allocate_slot
results.evidence: searches the 4 profile slots for an unused or matching one, resets it via FUN_0053b2b0, copies the caller's binding data into it, then calls FUN_0053b500 to finalize it
results.summary: Finds or reuses a free control-profile slot for a device and stores new binding data into it.

results.name: control_profile_finalize_slot
results.evidence: validates a profile slot's device-identifying fields via FUN_00490110 and, on success, hands off to FUN_0053b700
results.summary: Finalizes a newly written control-profile slot by validating its associated device identity.

results.name: control_profile_unbind_all_devices
results.evidence: iterates up to DAT_006b1844 profile entries, looks up each device id via FUN_004916e0, and clears its device<->profile-slot mapping in DAT_006b1a98/DAT_006b2ce8 when matched
results.summary: Clears all joystick/device-to-control-profile-slot mappings that reference a given profile array.

results.name: control_profile_bind_devices
results.evidence: first calls control_profile_unbind_all_devices to clear existing mappings, then iterates the 4 profile slots, looking up each device id via FUN_004916e0 and assigning free device<->slot mappings in DAT_006b1a98/DAT_006b2ce8
results.summary: Re-establishes device-to-control-profile-slot mappings for all connected joysticks/devices.
